scientific_integrity: Galla stationary diffusion formula, Goldie affine-tail machinery, and prior partial-reset results explicitly credited; stated parameter comparison is the assessed addition. No independent external mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-parameter one-dimensional expanding drift with independent Brownian input and homogeneous proportional Poisson contractions; no uniform spatial-tail/weak-reset limit, no elementary closed form for the tail amplitude. Relies on Goldie implicit-renewal theorem and Gaussian product-tail lemma.
title: Exact moment-loss wedge and Pareto-exponent reversal under frequent partial resetting
